The '''Crysfang Glade''' was an uncorrupted area of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]], named after [[Mawvorr|crysfangs]] that inhabited it.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crysfang Glade appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
